input.prompt: One large square processor package, an unfinished engineering sample, seen straight on from the front, centred, filling the frame. Painted light: no golden rays, the chip lit softly from the front, a thin green rim light on the left edge and a thin red rim light on the right edge, the void around it dark. Painted comic book illustration in exactly the style of the reference image (the green NVIDIA chip): a real object drawn sharp with clean black ink outlines on every part, comic halftone dots only inside the shadows, saturated colour. The object alone on a pure black void, seen clearly. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no flags, no signs, no markings anywhere.
